title: agelanthus heteromorphus
intro: Agelanthus heteromorphus, commonly known as the "witch's thorn", is a flowering plant in the family Loranthaceae. It is a parasitic plant that grows on the branches of certain tree species, particularly in the savannas and grasslands of sub-Saharan Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Agelanthus heteromorphus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects.
